flags.why: “Từ hai trăm nghìn” includes orders of exactly 200,000 dong, whereas “over” excludes them.
flags.fix: The shop offers free delivery for orders of 200,000 dong or more.

flags.why: “Ghèn” is primarily Southern vocabulary and needs a regional label ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/ghen-evS0pL6W4dHul.html)).

“Gia nhiệt” belongs to formal technical usage, so leaving it untagged misleadingly presents it as an everyday cooking verb ([technical usage](https://www.ipvietnam.gov.vn/documents/20182/1616475/37919.pdf/e69987d6-0cba-4918-a18f-7bf3a15e6b90)).
